# Verb + 得 + Adjective · *Verb + dak1 + Adjective*

**Meaning:** how well / how fast someone does something · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Verb endings and complements

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fdak1-degree).

To describe how an action is done, put 得 after the verb and then the description: 行得好慢 (walks slowly). If the verb has an object, say the verb twice: 講廣東話講得好好.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢講廣東話講得好好。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 hou2 hou2. |
| Yale | kéuih góng gwóng dūng wá góng dāk hóu hóu. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄍㄨㄛㄥ² ㄉㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚ² ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄏㄛㄨ². |
| English | She speaks Cantonese really well. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你寫字寫得好靚。** |
| Jyutping | nei5 se2 zi6 se2 dak1 hou2 leng3. |
| Yale | néih sé jih sé dāk hóu leng. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄙㄝ² ㄗㄧ⁶ ㄙㄝ² ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄌㄝㄥ³. |
| English | Your handwriting is beautiful. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢行得好慢。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 haang4 dak1 hou2 maan6. |
| Yale | kéuih hàahng dāk hóu maahn. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄚㄥ⁴ ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄇㄚㄣ⁶. |
| English | He walks very slowly. |
